work.title: Trois morceaux en forme de poire
work.movement: Complete: Manière de commencement; Prolongation du même; I. Lentement; II. Enlevé; III. Brutal; En plus; Redite

version.value: Original version for piano four hands
version.note: All seven pieces are included. The two players’ primo and secondo assignments and their performing edition are not specified on the carrier.

performers.note: Both are named as pianists on the transferred Musidisc LP and on the earlier Club français du disque issue.

date.note: Diapason’s reissue credits give 14 January 1959 for this work and these pianists; the Archive item gives the recording year 1959.

place.note: No recording venue is given in the consulted carrier, Archive or reissue credits.

catalogue.note: The transferred LP is dated 1970 by the Archive uploader. This is a later issue: the same work and pianists are catalogued by the BnF on Club français du disque 272, legal deposit 1962.

value.sideA: band II: Manière de commencement through Piece II
value.sideB: band I: Piece III, En plus, Redite

matrixTakeSides.note: The transfer joins the work across the original LP side break. Matrix and take numbers are not supplied.

credits.note: The transfer engineer is not named. Internet Archive hosts the uploaded transfer.

date.note: The item’s 2025 upload date does not establish when the LP was transferred.

processing.value: MP3 derivative of the uploaded FLAC transfer
processing.note: The file inventory identifies the FLAC parent. Playback equipment, equalisation, side-join procedure and restoration processing are not documented.

digital.format: VBR MP3 derived from an uploaded LP-transfer FLAC

composition.value: Public domain under the ordinary EU life-plus-70 term; Satie died in 1925.
composition.note: The original score was published in 1911. This is a territorial assessment, not a worldwide permission statement.

recording.value: EU public domain on the pre-1963 lawful-publication basis: the Poulenc–Février performance was issued on Club français du disque 272 by 1962.
recording.note: The BnF legal-deposit record documents the 1962 issue; the 1959 session and performer/work identity connect it to the later Musidisc RC 717 transfer. Matrix-level take identity is not established. The 1970 reissue date is not used as the first-publication date. The former 50-year term expired before the 2013 extension. No Archive Creative Commons grant or US recording clearance is claimed.

rights.creditLine: Erik Satie: Trois morceaux en forme de poire — Francis Poulenc and Jacques Février, piano four hands (1959). Club français du disque 272, published by 1962; transferred from Musidisc RC 717, hosted by Internet Archive. Territorial EU public-domain basis; US recording status not established.

sources.title: Satie: Trois morceaux en forme de poire, R.L. & Cie. 9799
sources.locator: Sibley Music Library scan of the Salabert reprint of the 1911 score; all seven movements, pp. 2–31; composer dates 1866–1925. Redite, pp. 30–31: the upper part’s repeated figure precedes its bien chanté melody; the closing dynamics are piano in the upper part and pianissimo in the lower.

editorial.timingNote: Seven movement-level sections follow the printed score and the transfer’s intervening pauses. Musical notes have passage precision; no bar-level listening review is claimed.
